title: ArchMaker Diagnostic
description: Typed, localized result of a validation stage. Codes come from the canonical AM-* catalog in docs/04-interfaces/errors-events.md. Contract state: draft.

blocking.description: Whether the diagnostic blocks manifest construction.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the offending location; empty string means the document root.

messageKey.description: Localization message key such as diagnostic.capabilityMissing or error.catalog.signatureInvalid.

params.description: Open parameter map for message interpolation. Documented open map required by the domain; values are scalars only.

source.description: Component that emitted the diagnostic, e.g. archmaker-resolver.

ruleId.description: Rule that produced the diagnostic, when applicable.
